property_summary: After setOwner is called by the admin with any address, the owner variable must be updated to that address; the buggy version leaves owner unchanged.
After setOwner is called by the admin, the owner state variable must equal the _owner argument passed; the buggy contract sets owner to msg.sender instead, violating this rule.
For any _owner input, after a successful setOwner call, the stored owner must equal the passed _owner argument; the buggy version breaks this rule because it assigns address(0) regardless.
After setOwner(_owner) is called by the admin, the owner variable must always equal the passed _owner; the bug overrides it to address(0), breaking the invariant.
Only the admin can change the owner; the buggy contract allows any caller to change it.
Only the admin can change the owner, so after a non-admin calls setOwner, the owner stays unchanged in the reference but can change in the buggy version.
Only the original admin can change the owner; the bug allows the current owner (who may not be admin) to also change it, violating the intended access control.
For any caller, if setOwner succeeds, the new owner must equal the original admin; the mutant allows a non-admin caller to set the owner to an arbitrary address, breaking this invariant.
After a call to setOwner by a non-admin caller that succeeds, the owner must not have changed; the mutant allows the current owner (who is not admin) to change owner to an arbitrary address.

For any caller, if the caller is not the original deployer, setOwner must revert because only the admin can change the owner; the buggy version allows the current owner (who may not be the deployer) to succeed, violating admin-only access control.
For any caller, if setOwner succeeds, the new owner must equal the caller; the mutant allows the current owner to set the owner to an arbitrary different address, breaking this invariant.
A successful call to setOwner by the admin must return true; the mutant breaks this by returning false.
After setOwner is called by admin with any address, the owner getter must return exactly that address; the bug offsets the stored address by 1.
For any caller, setOwner(address) must either succeed and update owner, or revert; the buggy modifier always reverts, so owner can never be changed.
For every caller, calling setOwner(any address) must not revert; the buggy modifier always reverts, so any call reverts.
Any non-admin address calling setOwner must revert; the buggy modifier removes the admin check, allowing non-admin to change the owner.
